reply.description: The subject — the thing shown by the view of that sort last in front on the stage (3.1), a kind, an id, a title and the view that shows it — or null when nothing is open.

chapter.description: Which chapter of the subject is open, named as a link names it: the day as YYYY-MM-DD for the Journal, the chapter's title in lowercase letters, digits and hyphens for a book. Absent when the subject has no chapters or none is known yet.

chapterTitle.description: The open chapter's title as the book gives it, for display; present exactly when chapter is.

tool.description: Tells which book the reader currently has open, and its title, or that no book is open. It covers books only: the note the reader has open, or the Highlights, has its own lookup, reading the open note. The journal is a book too; when it is the open book, the day its page shows has its own lookup, reading the open journal day. What they have open can change during the chat, so call this to know what "this" book or chapter refers to right now. Takes no arguments.
tool.label: Checking what's open
tool.name: /subject/title
